svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro, zoom: through the glass: the balcony and the city
svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216
Click the glass behind you (or Esc, B) to go back in · the vape, the terminal on the rail
The glass door works like the TV: from the room it
shows this view small, on the wall’s slant; click it
and the camera pushes through until the view fills
the screen. The balcony is that view, straight on,
The window by the mattress shows the same city.
